text:
sophie (support): FYI we just got an escalation from a customer (ACME) reporting duplicate charges after their app hit a timeout and retried. invoice shows ~1.2M extra tokens vs what their dashboard shows.
ryan (ingress): ugh. Do we have the raw request ids/headers from the time window? any evidence of replay at gateway?
jen (billing): customer included the invoice diff and a csv of metering lines. they say dashboard shows ~120k tokens for that window but invoice lines adds ~1.3M. they attached ticket #43218.
ticket-bot: New ticket created: #43218 — Billing discrepancy (customer-reported) — linked to thread 1765432198.
sophie (support): I pulled the proxy logs for that org during the timeframe. See snippet — looks like repeated ingress attempts after a 30s client timeout.

maria (platform): can you paste the proxy log lines? also what SDK version are they on?

sophie (support): log excerpt:

```
[2025-11-03T14:12:05Z] org=acme req_id=01A23 client_ip=10.2.3.4 route=/v1/generate status=200 latency=126ms tokens=642
[2025-11-03T14:12:36Z] org=acme req_id=01A23 client_ip=10.2.3.4 route=/v1/generate status=200 latency=114ms tokens=642
[2025-11-03T14:12:36Z] org=acme req_id=01A23-replay client_ip=10.2.3.4 route=/v1/generate status=200 latency=110ms tokens=642
```

sophie (support): they were on SDK v0.9.8 — client was doing a retry on their side after a 30s timeout and not setting an Idempotency header. the proxy appears to have accepted the replays as distinct billable requests (different internal ledger ids).

ryan (ingress): that req_id pattern `01A23-replay` suggests the client appended something instead of supplying an `Idempotency-Key`. our gateway dedup is based on `Idempotency-Key` header + org for 60s window. if none supplied, each request gets a new ledger entry.

jen (billing): that matches invoice delta. dashboard dedupe uses request_id mapping derived from successful responses logged by the app; if client retried but got the original response and dashboard read cached metrics, the dashboard shows less while ledger counts each accepted request.

maria (platform): reproduction plan: run a curl that times out client-side and then resends without Idempotency-Key. simple repro:

```
# first attempt (simulate server responds slowly)
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate --max-time 10
# client times out, then retry without idempotency
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate
```

ryan (ingress): can we confirm whether the ledger entry keys include the `Idempotency-Key` when provided? if so we should map the duplicate ledger rows back to the same customer request for reconciliation.

jen (billing): yes ledger rows have an `idempotency_key` column. but for these rows it's empty. I can run a query to aggregate tokens by (org, idempotency_key, timestamp_window).

sophie (support): customer is asking for a refund of the duplicate portion. their app was on SDK v0.9.8 which didn't auto-add idempotency for streaming calls. they've since upgraded in dev.

maria (platform): near-term mitigation: adjust gateway to treat identical `client_request_id` (when present) and identical payload+org within short window as candidate dedup. long-term: require/encourage Idempotency-Key on mutable endpoints and add a warning banner in Console when SDK version < 1.0.0 is detected.

ryan (ingress): low-friction fix: We can implement a 5s ingress dedupe based on SHA(payload)+org when `Idempotency-Key` is absent. risk: false positives for idempotent multi-sends? but for short windows should be safe.

jen (billing): for this customer I'll run a reconciliation script: identify rows for org=acme where idempotency_key is NULL and req fingerprints match within 60s, sum tokens and mark duplicates for credit. will need finance sign-off.

sophie (support): repro steps + patch notes and proposed credit plan are in ticket #43218. Customer accepted temporary credit while we fix. they asked we disable aggressive client retries in docs and add a note about idempotency.

ryan (ingress): technical action items assigned: (1) add short-window payload dedupe in ingress (maria+ryan) (2) console warning for old SDKs (maria) (3) billing reconciliation script + credit (jen).

sophie (support): thanks all — I'll update the customer thread with the timeline. ping me if you want me to attach the raw csv from the invoice.

jen (billing): I'll post the reconciliation results and proposed credit lines back here when run.

maria (platform): quick note: let's ensure the dedupe logs an audit flag so finance can trace why a ledger row was excluded from billing.

ryan (ingress): agreed. Also adding a small change to the SDK docs to show an `Idempotency-Key` example for retries.

sophie (support): closing loop — customer has been given temporary credit and is patching their client. marking as monitoring for a week. :white_check_mark:
